summary: iter85 CROSS-PLATFORM code review of the new Strategy Profile feature (per-strategy regime filter + default exit method, applied across Live/Paper/Lab). Verified all required data-testids/testIDs are wired correctly on WEB and MOBILE. Backend was already confirmed by main agent (pytest tests/test_strategy_profiles.py 4/4: unconfigured=35 entries, TREND_UP-only=1 entry, disabled=0 entries; curl confirmed apply-recommended/reset and 6 regimes exposed). Live UI verification via browser automation was BLOCKED by two independent issues that both surfaced during this run: (1) the same onboarding-overlay chain documented in iter84 (Coming Soon waitlist -> Welcome -> Provisioning) still fires and cannot be dismissed reliably inside the browser-automation loop-prevention limit; (2) the public ingress at hunter-squeeze-labs.preview.emergentagent.com returned intermittent 502s to browser fetch()/curl during this run (a 'Network issue - retrying shortly' toast surfaced in the app itself), even though backend supervisor logs show 200 OK for /api/auth/login and /api/strategy/*/profile calls from other sessions. Backend service is RUNNING and healthy on 127.0.0.1:8001 (verified via supervisor + logs). Code-review pass on the new UI components is clean and matches the backend contract on both surfaces.

issues: The Coming-Soon/Welcome/Provisioning overlay chain still fires on every fresh session and is hard to dismiss for automated E2E tests. Same finding as iter84 - please expose a ?skipOnboarding=1 URL flag or persist dismissal for owner sessions.
